evidence.detail: The composed Git/cache review course invokes all four retained QActions from Overview, Discuss and Threads through toolbar clicks, View menu activation and admitted physical key events; each of 36 entries reveals Review and performs its ordinary step once.

The composed course covers first/last file and change, no-open-comparison, no-changes and no-tab first-file entry; bounds retain exact source/reading position and the existing three-second message, while inactive actions remain disabled.

The exact older/reverse active-tab pair is restored before navigation. Delayed file/change entry runs once; unavailable material and later command/tab/file/comparison/Home/composer gestures cancel without retargeting. The final sibling assertion restores its unchanged semantic reading position.

Hidden and remembered Review drawers restore on entry and retain later changes inside Review. The composed summary draft survives the round trip; the full Qt window course verifies discussion selection, reading, filters, replies and existing draft retention.

Physical key entry focuses visible source after exact asynchronous restoration or the originating visible arrow for empty/unavailable Review. Editable multi-line keys retain their native text/caret behavior; Home, local-cycle and composer behavior retain existing checks.
